data.description: Comprehensive database of AI risks with causal and domain taxonomies, maintained by MIT researchers.
data.notes: Browsable risk database with causal taxonomy (what causes the risk) and domain taxonomy (what domain is affected). Risks are identified by slug names. The database is searchable and filterable at airisk.mit.edu.
data._item_pattern_note: Item-level IDs — AI risk slug name (lowercase hyphenated) — are not yet enumerated. A catch-all pattern ^[a-z]+(-[a-z]+)*$ was removed 2026-08-13: it matched any arbitrary token, fabricating resolution results for unrelated queries and polluting free-text search. Prior research note: Browsable risk database — risks can be explored at airisk.mit.edu/risks. No stable per-item URL scheme with formal identifiers. Restore an item-level match_node once the real identifier list is confirmed (prefer known_values over an open pattern).
